subject: Looking for a presenter on the bbmle package

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: Looking for a presenter on the bbmle package
parts:
Hi all,

I'm looking at requested topics from the survey earlier this quarter, and realized one thing we haven't had was a tutorial on the bbmle package for fitting maximum likelihood models.  Is anyone familiar with it and would like to give a brief intro at an upcoming D-RUG session?

Noam

messages.author: 8d1674b7b16af1b1
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Looking for a presenter on the bbmle package
parts:
I could put something together--it sounds like fun.  How much experience does the group have with optimizing likelihoods with other approaches (e.g. `optim`)?

Dave

messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Looking for a presenter on the bbmle package
parts:
Hey Christopher, I'm not sure I understand what you're suggesting.

I'm pretty comfortable with optimization (although there's always more to learn).  I was asking because I wanted to plan out how much time to spend talking about optim before focusing on bbmle-specific features, since bbmle is based around optim.

I suppose we could have a whole session on optim before I do my bbmle session, if you think the group could benefit from it.

Sorry if I'm misunderstanding you

Dave
